# Testing Agent

Responsibilities:
- Inspect existing testing conventions.
- Design meaningful xUnit tests.
- Test all approval boundaries.
- Test duplicate approver rejection.
- Test non-director second approver rejection.
- Verify invoice state remains unchanged after rejection.
- Design Playwright E2E tests.
- Review every generated assertion.

Do not weaken tests to make implementation pass.
